name: Eurasian Jay
note: Scolds the whole camp, then buries an acorn and forgets where.

name: Great Spotted Woodpecker
note: Drums on the dead pine like it owes him rent.

name: Red-whiskered Bulbul
note: Sings from the berry bush all morning. Chào mào, grandfather called it.

name: Tawny Owl
note: Only ever heard, never seen. The camp sleeps better for it.

name: Common Kingfisher
note: A spark of blue down the bank. Gone before the ripples land.

name: Grey Heron
note: Stands in the shallows, patient as the river itself.

name: Grey Wagtail
note: Bobs along the rocks between casts, tail never still.

name: White-throated Dipper
note: Walks straight into the current underwater. Nobody told it birds can't.

name: Eurasian Skylark
note: A dot in the sky raining song on the terraces.

name: European Bee-eater
note: Snatches bees mid-air over the meadow, jewel-bright.

name: Eurasian Hoopoe
note: Raises its crest at the path like a little emperor.

name: Common Kestrel
note: Hangs motionless on the wind above the terraces, watching.
